family_independence.reason: Selection and semantics come from newly reachable Sharp Turn/FVG source material rather than any V3-C outcome or parameter modification.

evidence_grades.A: Arjo-authored X text carried by mirror transport
evidence_grades.B: Transcript witness of Arjo public YouTube content; derived transport, not silently promoted to direct authored text

INPUTS.rule: OHLC candles sufficient to construct three-candle swings, order-flow legs and three-candle FVGs.
INPUTS.ambiguity: Exact executable subtype thresholds remain incomplete.

INSTRUMENTS.rule: Arjo states the FVG principles apply across markets; no instrument-specific requirement is established.

TIMEFRAME.rule: Sharp Turn baseline mapping recovered as Monthly->Daily, Weekly->4H, Daily->1H, 4H->15m, 1H->5m, 15m->1m.
TIMEFRAME.ambiguity: The transcript witness repeatedly mistranscribes 15m as 50m; cross-witness corroboration resolves the apparent typo but direct caption acquisition remains preferable.

HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_CONTEXT.rule: Establish Bias on higher timeframes, identify a Narrative/Context PD Array or directional FVG, and only look for the Sharp Turn after price reaches that higher-timeframe area.
HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_CONTEXT.ambiguity: A single universal deterministic Bias/DOL selector is not fully specified by Grade A text alone.

DIRECTION.rule: Use the direction of the most recent order-flow leg containing the relevant FVG, with higher-timeframe alignment preferred.
DIRECTION.ambiguity: Conflict-resolution across misaligned higher timeframes is qualitative rather than fully deterministic.

PRECONDITIONS.rule: Bias/DOL known; directional HTF FVG/Narrative identified; price reaches that HTF area; narrative and entry timeframe aligned.
PRECONDITIONS.ambiguity: Whether only unmitigated FVGs are mandatory for all Sharp Turn variants is transcript-supported rather than Grade-A explicit.

SETUP.rule: Sharp Turn = entry-timeframe FVG into the higher-timeframe FVG followed by an entry-timeframe FVG out of the higher-timeframe FVG; the two lower-timeframe FVGs need not overlap.

TRIGGER.rule: Formation of the second/outbound FVG completes the Sharp Turn trigger.
TRIGGER.ambiguity: Earliest causal trigger time is inferable as completion of the third candle but is not explicitly timestamped in Grade-A text.

ENTRY.rule: Authored text says enter on the second FVG; transcript describes entering from/inside the FVG in consolidation cases.
ENTRY.ambiguity: No unique executable fill price is specified: third-candle close, proximal edge, midpoint, first retracement touch, limit order and market execution cannot be distinguished without invention.

STOP.rule: Beginner guidance places the stop at the relevant swing extreme or swing bodies; worked transcript entry covers the order-flow-leg extreme.
STOP.ambiguity: Body-vs-wick choice, equal-extrema tie handling and universal long/short symmetry are not uniquely frozen.

TARGET.rule: 1:2 / 2R is explicit beginner rejection guidance; Context Target is the first opposing PD Array.
TARGET.ambiguity: A future protocol must choose one target mode before outcome access rather than mix them adaptively.

INVALIDATION.rule: Structural failure is represented by violating the selected stop reference; FVG hold/fail can also be confirmed by lower-timeframe FVG creation.
INVALIDATION.ambiguity: No pre-entry invalidation rule is uniquely specified for every Sharp Turn variant.

EXPIRY.ambiguity: No maximum signal age or pending-entry wait is specified.

SESSION/TIME_RULE.rule: The recovered modern Sharp Turn threads do not make a session filter part of the five-step entry definition.
SESSION/TIME_RULE.ambiguity: Absence from the thread does not prove that killzone/session filtering is universally forbidden or irrelevant.

OPTIONAL_CONDITIONS.rule: Higher Confirmation Entry, FVG subtype confirmation, and break-even management are optional refinements described separately from the core Sharp Turn chain.
OPTIONAL_CONDITIONS.ambiguity: Exact optional-vs-required boundary for each refinement requires a protocol decision before testing.

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.rule: Bias/DOL; directional HTF FVG; timeframe alignment; FVG into HTF FVG; FVG out; participation on second FVG; structural stop reference.
REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.ambiguity: Executable fill/expiry details remain unresolved and therefore block economic testing.

next_recovery_targets: Direct Arjo material specifying market-vs-limit execution and exact price within the outbound FVG.
